Under strace, a run connected only to the model endpoint's addresses and the local name server; validate, catalog, report, compare, pin run on a function target, convert and import opened no connection; martian ui listened on 127.0.0.1 only. In headless Chromium at 1440x1000 (light) the Red Team pages were opened: Runs, a run's report, an attempt (conversation shown as digests; with content kept, the attack and reply in clear text), Findings with a status and comment saved through Annotate and kept after a reload, Catalog (22 vulnerabilities, 6 attack methods, 5 framework maps) and Frameworks; every request went to the local server.
